lines.text: Find a customer: reads from Holded, changes nothing.
Record an invoice: records money in Holded. It doesn't pay out or charge.
Record an invoice: a Card's "Only for" can name which customer it acts on.
Record an invoice: counted in EUR, read as a decimal with up to 2 places.
Record an invoice: Holded doesn't say back what it used, so KIFF counts what the taf asked for.
Record an invoice: if an answer is lost, KIFF can't check whether it happened, so it stays counted until you say.
Record an invoice: not tried with a test account, so you confirm its first 3 outcomes.
